author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

This is the third collection of the “One Fruit for a Table” series, featuring Yunnan fruits such as kiwi, strawberry, star fruit, jackfruit, and goat milk fruit. Each fruit has its own aroma and character—some are sweet and juicy, some are bright and appetizing, and some carry a rich, lingering fragrance. Every bite holds the taste of the mountains and the season.

From branch to cutting board, from orchard to table, each fruit is turned into a feast of Yunnan flavors. Between sweetness and tartness, there is the gift of the land, and the simple warmth of a family gathered around the table.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
